proposed_additions.text: The first feature also carried a stage history. Sita Bibah was based on a play by Kamapal Mishra. Piyush Roy’s research places Goswami within touring rasalila and theatre, where he trained performers before moving into film. In Roy’s interview with historian Surya Deo, the first film is described as primarily gitinatya—musical drama. These are specific connections between repertoire, performers and a new medium.

Kalicharan Pattanaik offers another connection. Alok Baral places him among the makers of Odia gitinatya, while Kapilas Bhuyan’s cinema history credits him with lyrics for Lalita. Songwriters and performers carried skills across the stage and screen; the two histories meet through their work.
